steps.js: window.__tap = (x, y) => { const o = { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 }; document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); }; window.__until = (fn, ms) => new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (fn()) { clearInterval(t); r(true); } }, 20); setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(t); r(false); }, ms || 15000); }); FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); document.querySelector('.title .btn').click();

steps.name: заброс
steps.js: const p = FB.tutor.castPoint(); __tap(p.x, p.y); await __until(() => FB.fishing.phase === 'wait'); return FB.fishing.ctx.tut;

steps.name: перетянуть
steps.js: FB.fishing.holding = true; await __until(() => FB.fishing.tension > FB.fishing.zone.hi + 0.05, 5000); return FB.fishing.tension;

steps.name: тянем
steps.js: const F = FB.fishing; const t = setInterval(() => { const z = F.zone; F.holding = F.tension < (z.lo + z.hi) / 2; }, 30); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return { tension: F.tension, zone: F.zone };

steps.name: дотянуть
steps.js: await __until(() => FB.ui.isOpen(), 30000); FB.fishing.holding = false; return FB.fishing.phase;
